paragraphs.source_en: “I understand your meaning perfectly, my lord. But, my lord, if the Dutch and the English trade within our country under our banner, they may well provoke the very unrest you do not wish to see. You should know, my lord, that there are now six or seven hundred thousand servants of the Lord. If you mean to keep them under control…”

paragraphs.source_zh: “小人完全明白大人的意思。不过，大人，倘若尼德兰和英吉利打着我们的旗号和国内交易，说不定真会引起大人不愿看到的骚乱。大人当知，方今主的仆人计有六七十万，若想镇住他们……”

paragraphs.source_en: “Withdraw! Go.” Masamune had meant to thunder the command, but in the end his tone softened somewhat.

paragraphs.source_en: After Sōbei withdrew, Masamune told a servant, “Give that man some gold for his traveling expenses.”

paragraphs.source_en: His expression grew grave, and he began to calculate inwardly: Sōbei was certain to go to Osaka and say much the same as he had just said here. How would the believers react? Something had to be done! Having reached that conclusion, Masamune immediately wrote a letter to the shoshidai, Itakura Katsushige.

paragraphs.source_zh: 他表情变得凝重，心中亦开始盘算：宗兵卫必去大坂，说些和方才类似的话，对此，不知信徒们会作何反应？得采取行动！想毕，政宗立即给所司代板仓胜重修书一封。

paragraphs.source_en: The followers of the foreign faith do not wish Dutch ships to come to Japan, and the atmosphere grows ever more uneasy. One believer came to my humble residence to persuade me, but I rebuked him and sent him away. The man may visit fellow believers in Kyoto or Osaka. Though he is hardly cause for concern, one can never be too cautious…”

paragraphs.source_en: With the matter presented in this way, even if the man mentioned Masamune, Itakura would surely be reassured; besides, he must use his New Year’s visit to go to Sunpu and see Ieyasu, giving him a discreet warning, for the retired shogun was probably still unaware of the matter.

paragraphs.source_zh: 这样说后，即使那人提到政宗，板仓定也会释然；另，须趁拜年去骏府见家康，约略提醒，大御所恐还蒙在鼓中。

paragraphs.source_en: Masamune decided to visit Ieyasu at the beginning of the year and afterward convey Ieyasu’s intentions to Hidetada. In this way, he would become a man wholly devoted to offering counsel and plans for the Tokugawa shogunate. The discord between the old and new denominations would likewise reach Ieyasu’s ears as though it had come from Masamune himself.

paragraphs.source_zh: 政宗决定年初去拜访家康，回头将家康的意思转呈秀忠。如此，他便成为了一心为德川幕府献计献策之人。新旧教派彼此不合之事，也得以似从他口中灌到家康耳内。
